question: Does existing group-adaptive RL reward improve total tokens at preserved accuracy versus fixed RL reward with unchanged replay?
control_origin: Fresh round2 control recipe; no historical checkpoint substitution
only_treatment_difference: replay_reward; trial name/output path are bookkeeping

replay.admission: all verified successes in current group; no mixed-group admission
replay.verifier: existing training correctness + complete reasoning + nontruncation
replay.selection: first shortest total-token completion in group; replace same prompt only if strictly shorter
replay.eviction: oldest inserted distinct prompt; replacement does not refresh insertion order
replay.sampling: uniform one prompt from insertion-ordered buffer after current admission, including zero-variance groups
replay.note: Rules identical; actual rollouts, admissions, buffers and update counts may differ as a consequence of reward.

compute.policy: Same groups and generation caps, not a claim of equal realized tokens, optimizer updates or GPU-seconds. Report all actual costs/tokens/times. Incomplete trials are incomplete; no outcome-driven extensions.

evaluation.scope: exploratory development on previously used tuning set, not untouched confirmation
evaluation.paired_worker_blocks: Per training seed: evaluate fresh base + fresh fixed adapter + fresh adaptive adapter on same physical worker, pinned packages/model/questions/decoding/seeds. Record physical GPU identity.
evaluation.checkpoint: final adapter after 128 completed groups; no best-validation checkpoint selection
evaluation.training_validation: val-pilot diagnostic only; no reward, early stopping or checkpoint tuning from its accuracy
evaluation.primary: adaptive versus fixed total-token ratio; fresh base contextual and baseline preservation guard
evaluation.aggregation: Per question average over two samples; per domain arithmetic means; macro accuracy arithmetic across four domains and seeds; total-token ratio geometric across four domain ratios of seed-averaged means; thinking tokens separate

bootstrap.unit: resample three training-seed blocks with replacement, then question IDs within each domain with replacement; same question draws for all sampled blocks and all three arms; retain both samples together

evaluation.decision: Advance adaptive recipe only if lower accuracy CI >= -1pp for adaptive-fixed and adaptive-base at macro and each domain, upper macro total-token ratio CI adaptive/fixed < 1, and each training seed has point macro token ratio < 1. Otherwise report negative/inconclusive; never choose a lucky seed.
evaluation.missing_data: fail coverage/grading/pairing checks; do not silently drop records or replace seeds
evaluation.confirmation: No confirmation in this protocol; any finalist needs a separately locked fresh disjoint cohort.

budget.batch_budget_authorization: Not inferred from remaining headroom; reconcile existing user scope and live reservations before launch.

launch_gates: Integrator implements adaptive CLI dispatch and fixed regression checks; preserve original replay selector explicitly.
Freeze protocol, all resolved CLI arguments, source snapshot, requirements/software and data hashes in immutable registration before any paid call.
Read fresh campaign/controller/ledger/provider states; reconcile concurrent API+GPU liabilities and existing authorization; reserve atomically under shared cap, no duplicate rental.
Allocation RTX 4090 only; worker experiments.gpu_policy verifies actual GPU before model training; no fallback.
Keep completion marker, checksum backup verification, independent guard and confirmed GPU release; archive provenance.
next_phase: Any validation-accuracy controller is a separate registered experiment with disjoint fixed validation, cadence, smoothing, bounds and training-only interfaces. Never evaluation benchmark feedback.
